meta.defaultDescription: Curated luxury journeys through Egypt and beyond — private tours, Nile cruises and hand-picked stays.

offers.title: Limited-Edition Offers
offers.body: Discover our most prestigious seasonal journeys, curated for those who seek the extraordinary. These exclusive itineraries are available for a limited time only.
offers.empty: New offers are being curated. Please check back shortly.

footer.blurb: Curated journeys for the discerning traveler. Uncompromising quality in every aspect of your experience.

daily.title: Daily Tours
daily.description: Single-day journeys with fixed departures — see the most extraordinary sights of Egypt and be back by evening.

experiences.title: Full Experiences
experiences.description: Multi-day packages with a day-by-day itinerary, accommodation and a private guide throughout.

hotels.title: Hotels
hotels.description: Handpicked stays, priced per person by occupancy — single, double or triple.

transfers.title: Transfers
transfers.description: Private cars with professional drivers — airport pickups, city-to-city routes, or a trip built entirely around you.

airport.title: Airport Transfer
airport.description: Meet-and-greet arrivals and departures between the airport and your hotel, at a fixed price by zone and vehicle.

intercity.title: City to City
intercity.description: Direct routes between cities at a fixed price per vehicle class — no hidden extras.

custom.title: Custom Trip
custom.description: Tell us where you want to go and we will send you a personal quote on WhatsApp.

bicycles.title: Bicycles
bicycles.description: Rent by the hour or by the day, or join a guided ride along a planned route.

booking.title: Your booking
booking.description: Review your selection, add your details and confirm.

confirmation.title: Booking confirmed
confirmation.description: Thank you — a confirmation with your reference number is on its way to your inbox.
confirmation.emailNote: We have emailed you a confirmation. Our team will be in touch shortly to finalise the details.

booking.estimateNote: This is an estimate. We confirm the final price when we confirm your booking.

about.title: About Imperial Tours
about.description: Curated journeys for the discerning traveler, run by a team that lives and works in Egypt.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: Questions about a journey, a booking or a quote — we answer in English, Spanish and German.
